nodes.name: spin
nodes.coreScript:
-- Turns everything below it about the vertical axis while animating. Starts animating on its own, so the
-- scene moves as soon as it is opened.
local angle = 0
local STEP = 0.02

function init()
    setAnimating(true)
end

function invoke()
    if not (getStrobe() and getAnimating()) then
        return
    end

    angle = angle + STEP

    local c, s = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)

    setTransform({c, 0, -s, 0,  0, 1, 0, 0,  s, 0, c, 0,  0, 0, 0, 1})
end

nodes.name: bigCube
nodes.coreScript:
-- Builds a 20 unit cube once, centred on this node's origin.
local SIZE = 20
local COLOUR = {80, 160, 220, 255}

function init()
    local h = SIZE / 2
    local vertexes = {}

    local function quad(a, b, c, d, normal)
        for _, posn in ipairs({a, b, c, a, c, d}) do
            vertexes[#vertexes + 1] = Vertex{posn = posn, colour = COLOUR, normal = normal}
        end
    end

    quad({-h, -h, h}, {h, -h, h}, {h, h, h}, {-h, h, h}, {0, 0, 1})
    quad({h, -h, -h}, {-h, -h, -h}, {-h, h, -h}, {h, h, -h}, {0, 0, -1})
    quad({h, -h, h}, {h, -h, -h}, {h, h, -h}, {h, h, h}, {1, 0, 0})
    quad({-h, -h, -h}, {-h, -h, h}, {-h, h, h}, {-h, h, -h}, {-1, 0, 0})
    quad({-h, h, h}, {h, h, h}, {h, h, -h}, {-h, h, -h}, {0, 1, 0})
    quad({-h, -h, -h}, {h, -h, -h}, {h, -h, h}, {-h, -h, h}, {0, -1, 0})

    addVertexes(vertexes)
end

nodes.name: bigCubeLabel
nodes.coreScript:
-- Counts the strobes this label has seen, rewriting its text about once a second. Setting the same text
-- again changes nothing, so the scene is only sent again when the count shown actually moves on.
local strobes = 0
local STROBES_PER_UPDATE = 30

function invoke()
    if not getStrobe() then
        return
    end

    strobes = strobes + 1

    setText("Spinning cube\n" .. (strobes // STROBES_PER_UPDATE) .. " s")
end
